name: Harbor Roast
purpose: Online storefront for Harbor Roast, a small-batch coffee roaster. Visitors browse roasted coffees with photos and prices, build a cart, and check out as guests; signed-in customers can see their past orders.
actors: Guest shopper (can buy without an account)

entities.name: Product
relationships: has roast profile, tasting notes, price, and photo

entities.name: Order
relationships: has status, totals, and checkout email

entities.name: Customer
relationships: backed by OAuth account (Google/GitHub) with email

workflows.name: Browse catalog
workflows.description: Visitor sees the product grid with photos, prices, and roast profiles; can filter by category and open a product detail page

workflows.name: Cart and checkout
workflows.description: Add items to cart, adjust quantities, then check out guest-first with just an email; payment completes through the local test simulator in preview

workflows.name: Order history
workflows.description: Signed-in customers see their past orders with items, totals, and status; guests reach their receipt via a signed, expiring link

workflows.name: Admin management
workflows.description: Admin manages products (photo, price, roast profile, category, availability) and views orders

seed_demo: Eight seeded coffees across four categories (Espresso, Filter, Decaf, Merch) with photos, roast profiles, tasting notes, and prices; one seeded order for a sample customer so order history is visible in the demo.
